title: Have you seen Biscuit?
subtitle: Golden retriever, lost near Freedom Park on Monday, Nov 2
details_html:
• Male, 3 years old, 65 lbs, honey-colored coat
  • Pink collar with a brass tag
  • Very friendly and answers to “Biscuit”
  • Last seen by the duck pond around 6 PM
emergency_html:
Do not chase

He’s scared and fast. Crouch down, stay still, and call us right away.
contact_html: Call or text any time, day or night.
tabs_label: Take a number. Tell a neighbor.
venue_text: Freedom Park duck pond, Charlotte NC
